D: Doctor Strange protects a teenager who can travel between universes from a powerful witch.
P: Serve the snacks when Strange and America find the pizza ball stall.
S: the pizza balls Strange and America find in another universe
Pizza dough wrapped around cubes of mozzarella and pepperoni, rolled into balls, baked at 200C for 15 minutes, brushed with garlic butter and served with tomato sauce.
Christine's wedding salmon and fig canapés

Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and dill, and fig and goat's cheese bites. Warm 16 cocktail blinis at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 120g crème fraîche with lemon zest and top each blini with a spoon of it, a fold of smoked salmon and a dill sprig. Quarter 4 fresh figs. Sit each quarter on a small crostini with a little soft goat's cheese from 120g, drizzle with honey and add cracked pepper. Arrange both on a platter.
Chicken and spring onion dumplings with ginger, steamed 10 minutes, with a spicy tomato achar.
M: Ramen noodles in a pork and miso broth with braised pork belly, soft-boiled eggs, corn and nori, every bowl topped a little differently.
Wanda's dream of a family life

Beef meatballs browned and simmered 40 minutes in tomato sauce, served over spaghetti with garlic bread and parmesan, family style. Mix 600g beef mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, 30g grated parmesan, 2 crushed garlic cloves, parsley and salt and roll into 20 meatballs. Brown in olive oil and set aside. Soften 1 diced onion in the same pan, add 2 tins crushed tomatoes, a pinch of sugar and basil and simmer 15 minutes. Add the meatballs and simmer 25 minutes. Toss through 400g cooked spaghetti and serve with parmesan and garlic bread.
W: Nepali sweet rice rings from Kamar-Taj

Crisp Nepali sweet rice flour rings scented with cardamom and butter, fried golden in big loops and served warm from the pan. Mix 300g rice flour, 100g sugar, 50g melted butter, 1 tsp ground cardamom and 250ml milk into a thick batter and rest 1 hour. Pour rings into oil at 175C and fry until golden on both sides.
K: Black tea simmered with milk, cardamom, cinnamon, ginger and cloves, sweetened and strained.

s.note: the pizza balls Strange and America find in another universe
s.how: Cut pizza dough into small pieces and wrap each around a cube of mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni. Roll into balls and pack into a greased tin. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes, brush with garlic butter and serve with warm pizza sauce.

Mix 400g chicken mince with sliced spring onion and grated ginger. Fill dumpling wrappers, pleat and steam for 10 minutes. Char 3 tomatoes in a dry pan and blitz with chilli flakes, salt and a little garlic for a spicy achar to dip.

m.how: Braise 600g pork belly in soy and water for 2 hours, then slice. Whisk white miso into hot stock for the broth. Cook ramen noodles and soft-boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes. Build each bowl a little differently with pork, halved eggs, corn and nori.

w.note: Nepali sweet rice rings from Kamar-Taj
w.how: Mix 300g rice flour, 100g sugar, 50g melted butter, 1 tsp ground cardamom and 250ml milk into a thick batter and rest 1 hour. Pour rings into oil at 175C and fry until golden on both sides.

d.how: Simmer 500ml water with 4 crushed cardamom pods, 1 cinnamon stick, 4 slices ginger and 4 cloves for 5 minutes. Add 4 black tea bags and 500ml milk, bring just to the boil, sweeten with 3 tbsp sugar and strain into cups.
